articles.title: Pezeshkian calls environmental destruction caused by regional wars 'ecocide'
articles.summary:
Pezeshkian calls environmental destruction caused by regional wars 'ecocide'

Iran's President Masoud Pezeshkian has called the destruction of ecosystems caused by the "wars of aggression" an act of "ecocide", urging the international community to establish effective and enforceable mechanisms to protect biodiversity during armed conflicts.

Addressing the Leaders’ Summit of the 17th Conference of the Parties to the Convention on Biological Diversity, held in Armenia’s Yerevan on Friday, Pezeshkian said the US-Israeli war has damaged industrial and energy facilities, caused fires and released pollutants, contaminating soil and water and threatening natural ecosystems, according to Iran's Tasnim News Agency.

Pezeshkian described the environmental devastation caused by the wars in the region, including in Gaza, as “ecocide” that must be condemned, adding that pollution and ecological damage transcend national borders, Tasnim reported.

"War not only kills people and destroys economic infrastructure but also burns forests, damages wetlands, contaminates soil, threatens water resources and destroys wildlife habitats. 

"He warned that such damage can persist for years or even generations after hostilities end," he said.

articles.title: US lawmakers demand action after attack on Washington Post journalist
articles.summary:
US lawmakers demand action after attack on Washington Post journalist

US lawmakers have called on the Trump administration to hold Israeli settlers accountable after an attack on Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine and Palestinian villagers in the occupied West Bank.

Congresswoman Rosa DeLauro said the assault raised questions about the violence Palestinians face when there are no witnesses.

“If the settlers will do this to an American journalist on camera, in broad daylight, imagine what Palestinian families face when no one is watching,” DeLauro wrote on X. “Those responsible for this attack must be held accountable.”

If the settlers will do this to an American journalist on camera, in broad daylight, imagine what Palestinian families face when no one is watching. Those responsible for this attack must be held accountable.

— Rosa DeLauro (@rosadelauro) October 16, 2026

Senator Chris Van Hollen  described the “repeated violence and brazen impunity for attacks” against Americans and Palestinians as “unacceptable”.

“When will Trump and Rubio DO SOMETHING?” he asked in a post on X, urging the administration to take action against those responsible.

Congressman Ro Khanna said Israeli settlers operate with impunity and called for an end to US assistance.

“We need to cut off aid to Israel that is used to fund settler activity, and stop the sales of these weapons,” he wrote on X.

He recalled his own experience from July, when he and a New York Times photographer were detained by settlers in Khirbet Zanuta, saying that Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu called him a liar at the time.

“Netanyahu, you are the liar with the blood of Palestinian children on your hands,” Khanna said.

Israeli settlers beat Washington Post photographer Heidi Levine. She said attackers picked her up, then threw her down again and kept kicking. They operate with impunity. We need to cut off aid to Israel that is used to fund settler activity, and stop the sales of these weapons.

— Ro Khanna (@RoKhanna) October 16, 2026

Most minors subjected to solitary confinement in Israeli prisons Palestinians, report says
articles.summary:
Most minors subjected to solitary confinement in Israeli prisons Palestinians, report says

More than half of the minors held in Israeli prisons in 2025 were placed in solitary confinement at least once, including five boys aged 13 to 14, with the vast majority of the children being Palestinians, Haaretz reported, citing data obtained by two Israeli human rights organisations.

Of 635 minors held in prison, 351 were placed in solitary confinement, usually for seven consecutive days and sometimes for up to two weeks, according to the data obtained through a freedom of information request by the Public Committee Against Torture in Israel and Parents Against Child Detention.

The Israel Prison Service said 92% of the minors placed in isolation had not been sentenced. This included 176 held pending the conclusion of legal proceedings and 115 detained without trial under Shin Bet orders in administrative detention.

The data showed that solitary confinement was imposed 666 times, with 154 minors isolated more than once, including 42 who were placed in isolation between four and eight times.

Titi Carmel, director of Parents Against Child Detention, told Haaretz that the recurring use of solitary confinement was particularly concerning because of its potential harm to children.

articles.title: UKMTO says most vessels don't report Hormuz attacks
articles.summary:
UKMTO says most vessels don't report Hormuz attacks

The United Kingdom Maritime Trade Operations (UKMTO) has said it was struggling to establish the true number of attacks in the Strait of Hormuz because most vessels attacked were refusing to report incidents to the agency.

In its 'Voluntary Reporting Area Weekly Overview', the maritime security watchdog said that reports received through other sources could not always be verified. It also said that US-reported facilitated transit figures could not be independently verified.

Combined inbound and outbound transits through the Strait of Hormuz remained about 70 percent below pre-war levels, it said.

The UKMTO added that of the 12 vessels struck during its latest weekly reporting period--10 in Hormuz and one each in the Gulf and the Gulf of Oman--six continued their journeys or reached port, one was lost, and two were disabled or not under command.

Damage or outcomes remained unconfirmed in three cases, according to the report.

archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující diplomatický tlak kolem íránského jaderného programu a zvýšenou volatilitu na trzích s ropou v důsledku situace v Zálivu. Politická kampaň v Izraeli bude nadále dominovat místnímu zpravodajství a ovlivňovat tržní náladu.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued diplomatic pressure regarding Iran's nuclear program and heightened volatility in oil markets due to the Gulf situation are expected. Israel's political campaign will continue to dominate local news and influence market sentiment.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu zůstává vysoce napjatá kvůli přetrvávajícím střetům na Západním břehu, eskalaci kolem dodávek do Gazy a diplomatickým jednáním ohledně Sýrie a Libanonu. Írán navzdory sankcím nadále částečně exportuje energie, zatímco napětí v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu navyšuje rizika pro námořní dopravu a dodávky ropy.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region remains highly tense due to ongoing clashes in the West Bank, escalation regarding aid deliveries to Gaza, and diplomatic maneuvers concerning Syria and Lebanon. Despite sanctions, Iran continues partial energy exports, while rising tensions near the Strait of Hormuz increase risks to maritime traffic and oil supplies.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat pokračující diplomatické manévry ohledně Sýrie a Libanonu, přičemž napětí v Hormuzském průlivu bude nadále udržovat zvýšenou nervozitu na trzích s ropou.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, continued diplomatic maneuvers regarding Syria and Lebanon are expected, while tensions in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to maintain heightened nervousness in oil markets.

archive.security_status_cs: Situace v Gaze a na Západním břehu zůstává vysoce nestabilní kvůli pokračujícím střetům, přičemž mezinárodní tlak na Izrael roste kvůli humanitární krizi a osadnickému násilí. Současně eskaluje napětí v oblasti Hormuzského průlivu, kde dochází k útokům na plavidla a roste americký a spojenecký vojenský dohled.
archive.security_status_en: The situation in Gaza and the West Bank remains highly volatile amid ongoing clashes, with international pressure mounting on Israel over the humanitarian crisis and settler violence. Simultaneously, tensions in the Strait of Hormuz are escalating with vessel attacks and heightened US and allied military posture.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat další diplomatické třenice ohledně Západního břehu a Gazy, přičemž narušení námořní dopravy v Hormuzském průlivu bude nadále udržovat vysokou volatilitu cen ropy.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, further diplomatic friction regarding the West Bank and Gaza is expected, while disruptions to shipping in the Strait of Hormuz will continue to sustain high volatility in oil prices.

archive.security_status_cs: Bezpečnostní situace v regionu se výrazně vyhrotila kvůli přímým útokům na ropné tankery v Hormuzském průlivu, kde údajná exploze námořní miny poškodila supertanker. Zároveň eskaluje napětí na Západním břehu Jordánu po útocích osadníků na palestinské civilisty a zahraniční novináře, což vyvolalo ostrou mezinárodní kritiku. Írán a jeho regionální proxy sítě nadále udržují vysokou míru konfrontace, zatímco diplomatický tlak ze strany USA a Číny roste.
archive.security_status_en: The security situation in the region has escalated significantly due to direct attacks on oil tankers in the Strait of Hormuz, where a reported naval mine blast damaged a supertanker. Concurrently, tensions are mounting in the West Bank following settler attacks on Palestinian civilians and foreign journalists, drawing sharp international criticism. Iran and its regional proxy networks continue to maintain a high level of confrontation, while diplomatic pressure from the US and China intensifies.
archive.forecast_cs: V nejbližších dnech lze očekávat eskalaci napětí kolem Hormuzského průlivu, která udrží ceny ropy na zvýšených úrovních. Západní březek a diplomatická rovina budou čelit dalším tlakům kvůli střetům a otázkám lidských práv.
archive.forecast_en: Over the coming days, an escalation of tensions around the Strait of Hormuz is expected, keeping oil prices elevated. The West Bank and diplomatic spheres will face continued pressure due to clashes and human rights concerns.
